description_expanded: Welcome to Tutti Frutti, the perfect spot for your next getaway! Nestled in a quiet neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this pet-friendly home is just minutes from excellent restaurants, beach boutiques, and live entertainment. Tutti Frutti is a lovely cottage-style home with three bedrooms and two baths accommodating up to seven. Lovely finishes, beautiful details, and pastel shades set the stage for this peaceful retreat accented by pine hardwood flooring and shiplap ceilings. Share space in the open-concept living/dining area tastefully decorated with cozy furnishings. Gather on the sofa in the living room for a movie on the flat-screen TV, or around the dining room table with seating for four.  You’ll find the beautifully appointed kitchen bright and cheerful and loaded with plenty of counter and cabinet space. Grab a glass of wine, prep some snacks, and cook delicious meals together on nights you’d prefer to stay in. Afterward, hang out on the large screened-in porch showcasing the Florida landscape while the kids run around and play as the sun sinks into the horizon. When it’s time to settle in, enjoy peaceful bliss in the master suite with a king-sized bed, flat-screen TV, and en suite bath. You’ll also find two additional guest suites, just as inviting, while an outdoor shower will come in handy for washing the sand away after days at the beach. Rent some bikes and explore the surrounding communities of Seacrest, Seaside, and Rosemary Beach. Head to the beach, do a little shopping, then take your pick from an array of restaurants, including The Blue Pearl, Cafe Thirty-A, and The Perfect Pig, all featuring fresh, local cuisine, and all equally delicious. Please note: a dog is permitted, but it must be under 30 lbs and the non-refundable pet fee is an additional $300. Requests for pool heating must be submitted at least a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee if requested within the week of arrival. Pool heat is $50 per day and must be applied to the entirety of your stay. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
